models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models._note: Claude Haiku 5.5 (Anthropic, released 2026-10-07; API id claude-haiku-5-5). Small-tier model with adaptive thinking and effort levels (low/medium/high/xhigh/max); 1M context. Base id = max effort (Anthropic system card standard config; AA base slug claude-haiku-5-5 = Max). Pricing ≤100K-token prompts: $0.10 / $0.50 per M input/output, cache read $0.01, cache write $0.125; >100K prompts: $0.50 / $2.50, cache read $0.05, cache write $0.625. System card archived as resource/anthropic_claude-haiku-5.5_system-card_2026-10.pdf (144 pp.).

models.name: Mistral Large 4 Preview
models._note: Mistral Large 4 public preview (mistral.ai news 2026-10-06; API model mistral-large-4 / v26.10; weights announced for end of October 2026 — a separate GA entry will be added then). Natively multimodal MoE: ~1T total params (1.05T incl. 1.6B vision encoder), 52B active per token (AA lists 49B active), 1M-token context (AA tests 524K). Trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's European datacenters; preview served on the same infrastructure. List price $1.36 / $4.18 per M tokens, cached input $0.14 (50% launch discount: $0.68 / $2.09 / $0.07). AA Intelligence Index v4.3 38.4.

models.name: Kolibri
models._note: Aleph Alpha Kolibri (huggingface.co/Aleph-Alpha/kolibri-1, Apache 2.0, released early October 2026 — "Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri" news item; report draft dated late Sept 2026). Sovereign German/English MoE trained from scratch in Germany: 78.1B total parameters, 3.46B (4.4%) active per token, 1M-token context, FP8 weights ~78 GB (min. 2× H100 / 1× H200 / 1× B200), knowledge cutoff 2026-06-18, reasoning efforts, tool calling, agentic RAG focus. Tech report "Kolibri: A Sovereign European Model on the Pareto Frontier" (189 pp.) archived as resource/aleph-alpha_kolibri_tech-report_2026-10.pdf.
